options.content: Runtime health from persisted events. Prometheus scrape status is shown separately so a failed `/metrics` socket does not make the whole overview blank.

targets.rawSql:
WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange || ' ' || scope.symbol AS metric
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
),
data AS (
SELECT
  to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(to_timestamp((CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'t_end_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  ((e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange']) || ' ' || (e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol'])) AS metric,
  COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type = 'JointStrategyFrame'
  AND (e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','exchange']) = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (e.payload #>> ARRAY['local_market','symbol']) = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT

SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  CASE
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN substring(kv.key from 1 for length(kv.key) - 4)
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_ms' THEN substring(kv.key from 1 for length(kv.key) - 3)
  ELSE kv.key
END AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE
  WHEN kv.key LIKE '%_sec' THEN (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) * 1000.0
  ELSE (CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(kv.value, ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END)
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each_text(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['optimizer','timing'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS kv(key, value)
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  AND kv.key <> 'best_epoch'
  AND trim(kv.value) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  (floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) * GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM '${__interval}'::interval), 1.0)) AS "time",
  COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS metric,
  percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'latency_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'latency_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.event_type IN ('ExecutionSyncCompleted', 'ExecutionSyncFailed')
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND (e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[]) OR e.symbol IS NULL)
  AND e.payload->>'latency_ms' IS NOT NULL
  AND trim(e.payload->>'latency_ms') ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'timestamp_ms', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'timestamp_ms', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END) / 1000.0), e.ts))::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS "time",
  (COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):fills$'), 'unknown') || ' ' || COALESCE(COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol'), 'unknown') || ' ' || CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'side', '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END) AS metric,
  SUM(CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END) AS value
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT b."time", m.metric, COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.metric = m.metric
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS bucket,
    e.ts,
    COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS exchange,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'execution:state:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
latest_per_bucket AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (bucket, exchange)
    bucket,
    ts,
    exchange,
    payload
  FROM snapshots
  ORDER BY bucket, exchange, ts DESC
),
expanded AS (
  SELECT
    s.bucket,
    s.exchange,
    COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], 'unknown') AS symbol,
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','side'], '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM latest_per_bucket s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(s.payload->'live_orders', '{}'::jsonb)) AS open_order(key, value)
  WHERE COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange, scope.symbol, side.side
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('bid'), ('ask')) AS side(side)
),
data AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS "time",
    exchange,
    symbol,
    side,
    COUNT(*)::double precision AS value
  FROM expanded
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT
  b."time",
  (m.exchange || ' ' || m.symbol || ' ' || m.side) AS metric,
  COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.exchange = m.exchange
 AND d.symbol = m.symbol
 AND d.side = m.side
ORDER BY 1

WITH buckets AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeFrom())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ($__timeTo())::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)),
    make_interval(secs => GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001))
  ) AS "time"
),
snapshots AS (
  SELECT
    to_timestamp(floor(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (e.ts)::timestamptz) / GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) * GREATEST(COALESCE(NULLIF('${interval_ms}', '')::double precision, 1000.0) / 1000.0, 0.001)) AS bucket,
    e.ts,
    COALESCE(e.exchange, 'unknown') AS exchange,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'execution:state:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
),
latest_per_bucket AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (bucket, exchange)
    bucket,
    ts,
    exchange,
    payload
  FROM snapshots
  ORDER BY bucket, exchange, ts DESC
),
expanded AS (
  SELECT
    s.bucket,
    s.exchange,
    COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], 'unknown') AS symbol,
    CASE lower(trim(COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','side'], '')))
  WHEN 'buy' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'bid' THEN 'bid'
  WHEN 'sell' THEN 'ask'
  WHEN 'ask' THEN 'ask'
  ELSE 'unknown'
END AS side,
    CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(open_order.value->>'remaining_qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE 0.0
END AS qty
  FROM latest_per_bucket s
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(s.payload->'live_orders', '{}'::jsonb)) AS open_order(key, value)
  WHERE COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
),
metrics AS (
  SELECT scope.exchange, scope.symbol, side.side
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT e.exchange, e.symbol
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.event_type IN ('StrategyDecision', 'ControllerDiagnostics', 'JointTargetBook')
    AND e.exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND e.symbol IS NOT NULL
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  ) AS scope
  CROSS JOIN (VALUES ('bid'), ('ask')) AS side(side)
),
data AS (
  SELECT
    bucket AS "time",
    exchange,
    symbol,
    side,
    SUM(qty) AS value
  FROM expanded
  GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4
)
SELECT
  b."time",
  (m.exchange || ' ' || m.symbol || ' ' || m.side) AS metric,
  COALESCE(d.value, 0.0) AS value
FROM buckets b
CROSS JOIN metrics m
LEFT JOIN data d
  ON d."time" = b."time"
 AND d.exchange = m.exchange
 AND d.symbol = m.symbol
 AND d.side = m.side
ORDER BY 1

WITH latest_execution AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.exchange)
    'execution state'::text AS source,
    e.ts,
    e.exchange,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'execution:state:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY e.exchange, e.ts DESC
),
latest_private AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (COALESCE(e.exchange, substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$')))
    'private snapshot'::text AS source,
    e.ts,
    COALESCE(e.exchange, substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') AS exchange,
    e.payload
  FROM mm_events e
  WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':snapshot' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
    AND COALESCE(e.exchange, substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$'), 'unknown') = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
    AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.exchange, substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):snapshot$')), e.ts DESC
),
latest AS (
  SELECT * FROM latest_execution
  UNION ALL
  SELECT * FROM latest_private
)
SELECT
  l.source,
  l.ts,
  l.exchange,
  COUNT(open_order.key)::double precision AS open_order_count
FROM latest l
LEFT JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(
  CASE l.source
    WHEN 'execution state' THEN COALESCE(l.payload->'live_orders', '{}'::jsonb)
    ELSE COALESCE(l.payload->'open_orders', '{}'::jsonb)
  END
) AS open_order(key, value)
  ON COALESCE(open_order.value #>> ARRAY['order','symbol'], '') = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
GROUP BY l.source, l.ts, l.exchange
ORDER BY l.exchange, l.source

SELECT
  e.ts,
  COALESCE(e.exchange, e.payload->>'exchange', substring(e.topic from '^private:state:([^:]+):fills$'), 'unknown') AS exchange,
  COALESCE(e.symbol, e.payload->>'symbol', '') AS symbol,
  e.actor_id,
  e.payload->>'exchange_order_id' AS exchange_order_id,
  e.payload->>'side' AS side,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'qty', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS qty,
  CASE
  WHEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', '')) ~ '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$'
  THEN trim(COALESCE(e.payload->>'price', ''))::double precision
  ELSE NULL
END AS price,
  e.payload->>'timestamp_ms' AS fill_timestamp_ms,
  e.payload
FROM mm_events e
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'private:state:' || id || ':fills' FROM unnest(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 50

SELECT e.ts, gates.key AS exchange, gates.value->>'role' AS role,
       gates.value->>'live' AS live,
       gates.value->>'has_orders' AS has_orders,
       gates.value->>'can_sync' AS can_sync,
       e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','blocked_reasons'] AS frame_blocked_reasons,
       gates.value->'blocked_reasons' AS venue_blocked_reasons
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_each(COALESCE(e.payload #> ARRAY['execution_gates','venue_gates'], '{}'::jsonb)) AS gates
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 100

SELECT e.ts, e.actor_id, e.exchange, e.symbol, w.warning
FROM mm_events e
CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements_text(COALESCE(e.payload->'warnings', '[]'::jsonb)) AS w(warning)
WHERE e.topic = ANY (SELECT 'strategy:diagnostics:' || id FROM unnest(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[]) AS id)
  AND e.event_type = 'ControllerDiagnostics'
  AND e.exchange = ANY(ARRAY[${exchange:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.symbol = ANY(ARRAY[${symbol:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND e.actor_id = ANY(ARRAY[${actor_id:sqlstring}]::text[])
  AND $__timeFilter(e.ts)
ORDER BY e.ts DESC
LIMIT 25

list.definition:
SELECT exchange
FROM (
  SELECT exchange, max(latest_ts) AS latest_ts
  FROM (
  SELECT exchange, updated_at AS latest_ts
  FROM registry_exchanges
  WHERE status = 'active'
    AND exchange IS NOT NULL
    AND exchange <> ''
  ) sources
  WHERE exchange IS NOT NULL AND CAST(exchange AS text) <> ''
  GROUP BY exchange
) ranked
ORDER BY latest_ts DESC
